topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: Rain was just starting to drizzle down when I stepped up to the vacant spot. Used to be a sapling here, a symbol of hopes and prayers of a kid, or so the story goes. Now, it's just an empty hole, not even the dignity of a stump left. The kind of thing that leaves a cold hollowness inside, a void not easy to fill. I traced the outline of the soil with my shoe, wondering who decided this, if there was a damn good reason, and if they knew what they took with those chainsaws. Night's coming on, and the chill isn't just in the air.
